mapper.select:
select c.category_seq, c.name as category_name, count(*) as trade_count, round(avg(t.price)) as avg_price, nvl(sum(case when t.status = 'CONFIRMED' then t.price end), 0) as sales_amount from tbl_trade t inner join tbl_request r on r.request_seq = t.request_seq inner join tbl_category c on c.category_seq = r.category_seq where t.status != 'CANCELED'
and t.regdate >= trunc(sysdate) - (#{days} - 1)
group by c.category_seq, c.name order by avg_price desc
